title.id: Artikel baru: Apple Batasi Budget AI Engineer-nya $200 per Hari
title.en: New article: Apple's $200 Daily AI Budget Cap Tells Us More Than We Think

body.id: Satu tulisan baru ditambahkan ke blog: "Apple Batasi Budget AI Engineer-nya $200 per Hari". Tulisannya membahas apple membatasi penggunaan ai engineer-nya dengan anggaran $200 per hari — dan ini lebih banyak bicara soal industri daripada soal apple sendiri
body.en: A new article was added to the blog: "Apple's $200 Daily AI Budget Cap Tells Us More Than We Think". It covers apple capped engineers at $200 per day for external ai tools — and what that reveals about how the industry is really handling ai adoption
